name: field-modulated-decay
title: Field-to-particle coupling, A_particle -> 0 at rate k·[B](x)

readouts.name: a2_static_field_max_abs_z
readouts.description: max |z| over x-columns of survivors vs N0·exp(-k·B·t) (static B)

readouts.name: a2_zero_field_decays
readouts.description: molecules lost from the B = 0 column (must be 0)

readouts.name: a2_continuum_rel_l2_err
readouts.description: relative L2 of ensemble-mean A vs the continuum FV solution

readouts.name: a2_continuum_total_rel_err
readouts.description: relative error of ensemble-mean total A vs continuum

readouts.name: a2_native_static_field_max_abs_z
readouts.description: native VCell hybrid, static-B column survival |z|

readouts.name: a2_cosim_vs_native_diffusing_profile_z
readouts.description: co-sim vs native diffusing final x-profile |z|

question:
Does the Smoldyn process read the PDE field at each molecule as vcell-fvsolver does
(nearest node, value from the previous coupling step)? Does the coupled model approach
its deterministic continuum limit?
hypothesis:
With a static field and immobile particles, each grid column survives as exp(-k·B·t)
exactly in expectation, and nothing decays where B = 0. With diffusing A and B, the
ensemble-mean particle concentration matches the all-continuous FV solution of the same
model, to within sampling noise.
objective:
Part 1: B rises linearly from 0 to 1 µM across x; 4,000 immobile A per run; k = 1/(µM·s);
8 seeds; t = 1 s. Compare per-column survival to exp(-k·B_col·t) with binomial z-scores.
Part 2: B is a Gaussian (1 µM peak, D_B = 0.5); 20,000 A with D_A = 1; 8 seeds. Compare
the ensemble-mean A (µM) at t = 1 s to continuum_model() solved by FVReactionDiffusion
alone (relative L2 over the grid, and total A).
description:
The reaction is written once in the HybridModel (A + B -> B, k). partition() sends the
PDE side nothing (B is a catalyst), and sends the particle side A -> 0 with the rate
k*B; that Smoldyn evaluates through GridValueProvider at each molecule's nearest node.
Coupling is coupling: fvsolver with k = 1 (dt = 0.01).

variants.name: native-vcell-slab
variants.note: The same model on a quasi-2D slab (11x11x3), run by both the co-simulation (Poisson initial placement) and VCell's native hybrid solver via viva_pde_particle.reference.vcell_native (pyvcell -> libvcell -> vcell-fvsolver).

variants.name: native-vcell-slab
variants.diff_from_baseline: Same model on a quasi-2D slab (11×11×3), run by both co-sim and VCell's native hybrid; 8 seeds each.

variants.name: continuum-limit
variants.diff_from_baseline: Gaussian B (D_B=0.5), 20,000 diffusing A (D_A=1), 8 seeds; compared to the all-continuous FV solution.

simulation_set.name: default
simulation_set.description: Static-field column survival + continuum-limit comparison + native-slab agreement (8 seeds each); results/metrics.json.

behavior_tests.name: survival-follows-local-field
behavior_tests.description: Max |z| over x-columns of survivors vs N0·exp(-k·B_col·t) (static B, immobile A).

provenance.note: Smoldyn's first-order reaction probability per step is 1-exp(-rate·dt), so survival is exp(-k·B·t) exactly in expectation.

behavior_tests.name: no-decay-where-field-is-zero
behavior_tests.description: Molecules lost from the B = 0 column.

provenance.note: Rate k·0 = 0 at the B = 0 nodes.

behavior_tests.name: approaches-continuum-limit
behavior_tests.description: Relative L2 error of the ensemble-mean A (µM) vs the continuum FV solution at t = 1 s.

provenance.note: Per-node sampling noise of the 8-run mean is about 1/sqrt(8·165), roughly 2.8%; the threshold allows about 2x that.

behavior_tests.name: total-matches-continuum
behavior_tests.description: Relative error of the ensemble-mean total A vs the continuum total at t = 1 s.

provenance.note: 160,000 total molecule samples give ~0.3% sampling error on the total.

behavior_tests.name: native-vcell-follows-local-field
behavior_tests.description: Native VCell hybrid, static B (slab, 8 seeds); max |z| over x-columns of survivors vs N0·exp(-k·B·t).

provenance.note: Same exact expectation as the co-simulation test; validates the headless native reference path.

behavior_tests.name: cosim-matches-native-static
behavior_tests.description: Two-sample max |z| over x-columns of per-run survival fractions, co-simulation vs native VCell (static B).

provenance.note: Equal expected survival under both solvers; 8 runs each.

behavior_tests.name: cosim-matches-native-diffusing
behavior_tests.description: Two-sample max |z| over x-columns of the final A profile, co-simulation vs native VCell (diffusing A and B).

provenance.note: Same model, mesh and coupling scheme in both solvers; differences only from sampling (8 runs each).

behavior_tests.name: cosim-matches-native-total
behavior_tests.description: Relative difference of mean total survival, co-simulation vs native VCell (diffusing A and B).

provenance.note: 160,000 molecule samples per solver; sampling error ~0.5%.

pipeline_gate.proceed_condition: The particle side reads fields correctly and the coupled model converges to its continuum limit.

canonical_runs.name: default
canonical_runs.label: Static-field column survival + continuum-limit comparison (8 seeds each)

findings.statement: The particle side reads the PDE field correctly: with static B and immobile A, per- column survival matches N0·exp(-k·B_col·t) with max |z| = 1.56 (co-sim) and 1.68 (native VCell), both well under the |z| < 4 band, and exactly zero molecules decay in the B = 0 column.
findings.next_action: None — field read confirmed against the exact expectation on both solvers.

findings.statement: The coupled model converges to its deterministic continuum limit: with diffusing A and a Gaussian B, the ensemble-mean A is within 2.7% relative L2 (band 6%) and the total A within 0.05% (band 2%) of the all-continuous FV solution — both at the sampling-noise level.

The co-simulation and VCell's native hybrid are statistically indistinguishable on this field-to-particle coupling: static-field survival agrees at max |z| = 1.37, the diffusing final x-profiles at |z| = 2.54, and total survival to 0.04%, with the B fields identical to 1e-16 — so GridValueProvider's nearest-node field read is reproduced by the process-bigraph decomposition.
findings.next_action: Clears the pipeline gate to two-way-exchange; no further action for this model.

regression_compatibility.basis: results/metrics.json is committed and regenerated by sims/run.py; all eight behavior tests pass (static |z|=1.56, native |z|=1.68, continuum L2 2.7%, cosim-vs-native profile |z|=2.54).

biological_validation.basis: Per-column survival matches the exact exp(-k·B·t) expectation (|z|=1.56) with no decay where B=0, and the coupled model converges to the continuum FV solution within 2.7% L2.

explanatory_gain.basis: F-03 shows the process-bigraph decomposition reproduces VCell's nearest-node GridValueProvider field read (B fields identical to 1e-16; survival/profile agreement within sampling), validating the headless native reference path.

conclusion_logic.if_primary_tests_pass: The Smoldyn particle side reads the PDE field as vcell-fvsolver does (exact exp(-k·B·t) survival, no decay where B=0), the coupled model reaches its continuum limit within sampling, and the co-simulation and native VCell hybrid are statistically indistinguishable — clearing the pipeline gate to the two-way-exchange study.
conclusion_logic.if_primary_tests_fail: A static-field |z| ≥ 4, any decay in the B=0 column, a continuum L2 ≥ 6%, or a cosim-vs-native |z| ≥ 4 would mean the field read, units/binning or coupling diverged — re-examine partition() and GridValueProvider before advancing the pipeline.

report.caveat: Agreement bands are theory/sampling-based (8 seeds each), not literature-matched; the native-slab arm needs the dev pixi env.

rerun.note: Static-field column survival + continuum-limit comparison + native-slab agreement (8 seeds each). The native-slab arm needs the dev pixi env (pyvcell spatial-hybrid); in the default env only the co-sim arms run.
